work.h2a: What we actually do to look after your

steps.t: Watch every client site, with named alerts.
steps.d: Uptime for the site, forms and checkout is watched, and an alert reaches a person, not an unread inbox.

steps.t: Keep off-site backups and test a restore.
steps.d: Copies are stored away from the host, and a restore is tried, so you know it works before you need it.

steps.t: Try updates on a copy first.
steps.d: Core, theme and plugin updates are tested on a copy, then made live, so a client site is not your test bed.

steps.t: Run security checks on a schedule.
steps.d: Malware scans, login protection and known vulnerabilities are reviewed on a routine, with fixes logged for you.

steps.t: Send a monthly report you can forward.
steps.d: Done, Watch and Next in plain words, ready to send to your client with your logo on it.
